We went 9 month ago to submit all the documents physically and got the appointment for the interview for May. The clerk said the lawyer should’ve been uploading updated Documents for the last 9 month, but I will get the visa for sure. The clerk said to upload the documents and then she will hand out the visa right away. 
This didn’t work for my lawyer online after the interview. 
Yesterday we went to MH with all the documents printed out but the woman working there refused to take them. She said literally they don’t take any physical documents and the lawyer needs to do it online…
